whyMatters: Many NRIs complete a sale and then get stuck for months at the bank because the tax certification or source-of-funds trail isn't right. Handling repatriation properly is what actually gets your money out of India, on time and within the rules.

faqs.q: How much can an NRI repatriate?
faqs.a: Commonly up to USD 1 million per financial year from NRO funds, subject to RBI rules and proper documentation. Your specific case should be confirmed with your bank/CA.

faqs.q: What are Form 15CA and 15CB?
faqs.a: 15CB is a chartered accountant's certificate on the remittance and its tax; 15CA is the declaration filed with the tax department. Both are typically needed to remit.

faqs.q: Is TDS deducted on my sale?
faqs.a: Yes — NRI property sales attract TDS, often at higher rates. Correct handling (and any refund) is part of the process.
